title: Move the whole Press into the Drag controller
lede: A Press used to be spread over `Note` (Raise, twice), `useDrag` (`isDragPress`) and the controller, which saw a Press end inside the Dead zone and dropped it. Now the controller owns the whole Press: a Drag kind's `press` Raises before anything listens, a real release inside the Dead zone is reported as a Click through `io.click`, and a Press inside text only Raises. #7 will use the Click to start Editing.

files.question: Which Drag kind does a press on this Note start?
files.summary: Picks `moveKind` or a resize kind and calls `start`. It no longer dispatches Raise itself.
files.owns: Mapping the press target to a Drag kind.
files.never: Raises, filters buttons, or measures the Dead zone.
files.tested: Browser tests with real mouse input.

files.question: Which presses reach the controller, and how?
files.summary: Drops non-primary and non-left presses. A press in text goes to the controller with `inText` and no capture; any other press is captured first.
files.owns: DOM filtering, `preventDefault`, pointer capture, and the real `DragIO`, including `click` → `onClick`.
files.tested: Browser tests. Not in the coverage gate.

files.question: Is this pointerdown a Press, and is it inside text?
files.summary: `isPress` and `isInText`, the two checks that used to be `isDragPress`.

files.question: When does each thing happen in a Press?
files.summary: `press` dispatches the kind's `press` action first, then (outside text) starts a session. `end` reports a Click only for a real release inside the Dead zone, after letting go.
files.owns: Order of Raise, listeners, Click, Preview and commit.
files.never: Touches the DOM or knows what a Note is.
files.tested: Node tests against a recording fake `DragIO`.

files.question: What does a Press save at once?
files.summary: Both `moveKind` and every resize kind have `press: raise`.
files.owns: Turning a Press, a Preview and a release into Note actions.
files.tested: Through the controller tests and browser tests.

scenarios.name: pointerdown, then pointerup without leaving the Dead zone: a Click

steps.title: pointerdown on the Note's body
steps.explain: `Note` only picks the kind. Raise is no longer here, so it can't run before the button check.

steps.title: useDrag filters, then captures
steps.explain: A right-button press stops at `isPress`, before anything is dispatched. Outside text the press is captured and handed to the controller.

steps.title: The controller Raises, then listens
steps.explain: Raise goes out before `attachPointerListeners`, so the Note is in front from the first frame and stays there for the whole Drag. The test `raises the Note before anything listens` checks this order.

steps.title: pointerup inside the Dead zone
steps.explain: Only `up` passes `released`. The session is cleared, listeners detached and capture released first; the Click comes last, so #7 can focus the textarea without the capture fighting it.

scenarios.name: A Press that ends without being seen: no Click

steps.title: A move with no button down, pointercancel, Escape or dispose
steps.explain: All of these call `end` without `released`, so a pending Press ends silently: neither a Click nor a Drag. The `it.each` test `ending inside the Dead zone by … is not a Click` covers all four.

steps.title: The press is inside a textarea
steps.explain: No `preventDefault` and no capture, so the caret and text selection keep working. The controller still Raises, then returns before any session exists, so no listeners and no Click. Nothing renders a textarea until #7, so this path is proven by the controller test `inside text it only raises`; the browser test is deferred to #7.

notes.title: Raise lives on the Drag kind, not in the controller
notes.detail: The controller stays Note-agnostic. Counter-argument (from review): `press` is optional and may return `null`, yet both kinds always Raise, so a required member would be simpler.

notes.title: A right-button press no longer Raises
notes.detail: Before, Raise ran ahead of the button check by accident of ordering. Covered by the browser test `a right-button press does not raise the Note`.

notes.title: No Drag from inside text
notes.detail: Dragging in a textarea is text selection, which #7 requires. While Editing, the Grip strip moves the Note.

notes.title: `commits()` in the controller tests
notes.detail: Every Press now dispatches a Raise, so the existing tests assert on `commits()`, every dispatch except Raise, to keep asserting what a release saves.
